neighbours.label: A list of later pieces in split names: 'oul' in Desmoulins, 'borough' in Desborough, 'ner' in Rosner and Kessner, 'ais' in Desmarais; other names in the slot stay quiet, including other Des- and De- names.
fire: A biography of Lucie Desmoulins came out in Paris.
Her cousin Desmoulins kept all the letters.
Trains stop at Desborough twice a day.
Back in Desborough, the mill was closed.
Rabbi Rosner spoke at the small service.
Judge Kessner read the verdict aloud.
Our neighbor Paul Desmarais sold the farm.
Lawyers for Anna Rosner filed the appeal.
quiet: A biography of Lucie Martin came out in Paris.
Her cousin Deschamps kept all the letters.
Trains stop at Northampton twice a day.
Back in Leicester, the mill was closed.
Rabbi Cohen spoke at the small service.
Judge DeVries read the verdict aloud.
Our neighbor Paul Taylor sold the farm.
Lawyers for Anna Fischer filed the appeal.
